title: Rhythm and Rust
logline: A shy, matte-grey robot overcomes its social glitches when a vibrant neon dancer invites it to join the groove at a futuristic rooftop party.
theme: Overcoming social anxiety and finding your rhythm with a little help.

characters.name: Bolt
characters.one_line_description: A shy, matte-grey robot with blinking blue optical sensors and slightly creaky joints.

characters.name: Spark
characters.one_line_description: An outgoing, sleek chrome robot decorated with pulsing pink neon lights and fluid joints.

scenes.title: The Wallflower
scenes.summary: On a futuristic rooftop bustling with dancing robots under a neon sky, Bolt stands awkwardly in the corner, clutching a oil-can drink.

scenes.title: The Invitation
scenes.summary: Spark glides through the crowd, notices Bolt hiding in the shadows, and dances over with an inviting wave and a warm, glowing digital smile.

scenes.title: The First Step
scenes.summary: Spark demonstrates a simple, rhythmic side-to-side shuffle. Bolt hesitates, its gears whirring loudly as it tries to mimic the movements.

scenes.title: Finding the Groove
scenes.summary: Bolt gets the hang of the movement. Its blue optical sensors light up brighter as it begins to swing its metallic arms in sync with Spark.

scenes.title: Rooftop Symphony
scenes.summary: The camera pulls back as Bolt and Spark sync their dance moves perfectly, surrounded by cheering partygoers under the neon city lights.

source_idea: A shy robot learns to dance at a rooftop party
